decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch draws directly on the firm's woodworking, assembly and lighting know-how, so management can interpret its sales and refresh models instead of withdrawing it, although its absence from the website since 2020 adds some risk.
The one-tier pyramid is a core Erzgebirge product that sits fully within the firm's craft knowledge, so its results are easy to read and it remains a stable part of the range.

This platform is an accessory to the electronic music box line withdrawn in 2019, lies outside the firm's competence and has lost its anchor product, so its resources are better returned to core craftsmanship.

Although its Christmas motif uses the firm's carving and painting skills, the platform depends on the abandoned music box technology the firm cannot develop further, so continuing it offers little learning or commercial value.
The Dresden-themed pyramid extends the firm's established pyramid craft and regional design knowledge, giving management a clear basis to evaluate and refine it.
